walk.environment:
Build: read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/tree at 0deff9c4, left unchanged. `git status --ignored` afterwards shows only the pre-existing ignored audit/ log folder that every walker's server appends to, and no configs/source_qualification.yml. One mistake to disclose: while checking whether the tree was writable I created an empty file /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/tree/.probe, then deleted it seconds later. No git command touched the tree.

App: started by /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/launch.py. It removes every *proxy* variable plus OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT, sets cwd and PYTHONPATH to the tree, imports src.api.main and calls main() (never `-m`). The log confirms `SRC FROM /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/tree/src/api/main.py`. Environment as in the first walk: OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1, OO_AUTOSEED=0, OO_LLM_AUTOSTART=0, OO_PORT=8924, OO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/data.

One difference from the first walk: it served from a git-archive copy and wrote the S7 overlay into that copy. I ran from the worktree, so the launcher sets `DEFAULT_OVERLAY_PATH` in src.catalog.qualification_overlay to /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/configs/source_qualification.yml. That module reads it at call time, and qualification_merge imports it inside the function. Nothing was written into the tree.

S10 launches injected `machine_floor._mem_readings = (3924.0, 800.0)`, the second one also with OO_ALLOW_BIG_SCANS=1. Servers were stopped by PID only: 27140 (main), 642 (small), 1144 (override), 2663 (small, consent probe), 3847 (fresh seed, phase D).

Seed: docs/audit/sources-admission-clickthrough-2026-09-18/seed.py, copied to /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/seed.py with sys.path pointed at the tree. Before seeding, scheduler_settings.json {"scrape_unqualified": true} was written to the data folder. The seed ran with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026, OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset, OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1 and OO_AUTOSEED=0. It printed sources 11, collecting 3, admission events 3 (undone 1), unaccounted 2 of 3.

Encryption proof:
- The DB header bytes are b'\xadl{\xa7...', not 'SQLite format 3'.
- /api/system/lock-state read {"state":"locked","plaintext_mode":false} at every one of the five boots.
- Every boot was unlocked in Chromium through #pw and #btn-unlock.

Data: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/data.snapshot is the fresh seed. The main walk's state is kept as data.after-main-walk, and phase D ran on a fresh copy of the snapshot. No first-walk folder was copied.

Browser: Playwright with Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking, --disable-component-update, --no-proxy-server, proxy variables removed from the driver and the browser env. Main pass at 1440x950 in en, a live switch to fr, then fresh fr, zh and ar. 375x800 passes in en and ar, plus a 375 pass on the fresh seed.

Network:
- The OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1 boot starts online, so every boot's first action was one real click on #net-toggle to go offline. No consent popup appears for that direction, and /api/system/network then read online:false.
- The page listener recorded zero non-loopback requests in every phase.
- The one consent popup this row reaches ("Qualify the backlog") was opened three times (en and ar on the override boot, en on the small boot), read, screenshotted and cancelled with "Stay offline". I never pressed "Go online".

Scripts, logs, raw_*.json and 92 screenshots are under /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/.

Numbering in this report: S1–S10 and L375 are walk steps. Defect ids in old_defects are row+n from defects.csv, so defect S1 is the step-S8 merge defect (F3), not step S1.

new_defects.title: 375 px: the admission-audit rows collapse to a ~46 px info column, and the nowrap timestamp spills out of it (a regression from the S8 stamp fix)
new_defects.repro:
1. On the row-S seed, at a 375x800 viewport in en (or ar), open Settings → Advanced and expand Quality gates.
2. Scroll to Admission audit.
new_defects.expected: The two-column stack the first walk measured at this width: info and action each readable, the timestamp inside its column, with no word-per-line wrapping.
new_defects.actual: The action column (for example 'Undone September 18, 2026 at 01:00 PM', which is nowrap) takes 190–250 px. The info column shrinks to 46 px (x 35–81), so 'admitted-/then-/refused.example' and 'Collection / was: / off ·' break one word per line (row height 213 px). The nowrap timestamp 'September 18, 2026 at 12:00 PM' extends to x=235, 154 px past its own column, under the action column. In ar the undone stamp sits jammed against the info fragments.
new_defects.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/shots/S-D-375-admission-fresh-en.png, S-375-admission-en.png, S-375-admission-ar.png. /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S/raw_d.json steps.narrow_fresh.rows: info_w 46 / 102 / 232, ts_overflows_column_by 154 / 98. Compare the first walk's docs/audit/delegated-clickthrough-2026-09-26/shots/S/S-375-admission-en.png.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/app-ai-tools.js:315 gives the action div `style="flex:0 0 auto"`, and :280 makes each .qual-when span `white-space:nowrap`. Both were added by 9fe5530a (B9, S8). At narrow width src/static/app.css:1771 sets `.row > div { min-width:0 }`, so the info div absorbs all the shrink. A fix could let the row wrap, or give the action column a max-width or allow its stamp to wrap below ~600 px.

walk.summary:
Row S still fails, on one step: 10 of 11 steps pass on the fixed build, and L375 fails on a regression the S8 stamp fix introduced. All eight row-S defects are fixed. So are six other rows' defects on surfaces this row walks (H8, P7, U5, T3, H1, P1), and P2 for the airplane button, on the bubble's text alone. The build was 0deff9c4, encrypted and locked at every boot, unlocked through #pw each time, and kept in airplane mode throughout.

What works now:
- **S1–S3:** every count matches the seed. Home no longer shows the flat total.
- **S4:** a live switch to French repaints the whole Quality gates panel, the Home strip and the Library tiles.
- **S5:** fr, zh and ar render fully translated, with correct RTL placement in ar. The retired-hatch line names the real path in each UI's own labels.
- **S6:** in ar, Undo updates the headline at once.
- **S7–S9:** the overlay editor works end to end. Export's YAML now merges, and every refusal is shown under the button with no TypeError.
- **S10:** the memory-floor refusal and its override show as named.

The layout regression (P3): at 375 px the admission rows collapse. The info column shrinks to about 46 px and prints one word per line, and the nowrap timestamp runs 154 px past its column. The first walk measured a clean two-column stack there. Page overflow is still 0 at 375 px on Home, Quality gates and Library in en and ar.

The other nine new defects, all P3:
- **Stale backlog count:** the 'Catch up the backlog' line does not follow Undo, Adopt or Revert (UI 5 vs API 6; UI 6 vs API 3). Same class as F1.
- **English on translated pages:** the Preview targets result, the memory-floor reason, and the merge refusals the F3 fix made visible.
- **Consent for a refused job:** 'Qualify the backlog' still opens the go-online popup when the panel already says the machine declines qualification.
- **Checkbox layout:** 'Judge sources automatically' sits on its own line above its label.
- **Run-on caveat:** the 'N of M collecting sources are not accounted for here' line runs into its note with no full stop; English caveats use ASCII '--'.
- **Wrong hover:** 'Discovered candidates' is described as 'awaiting review' for every disabled source, including one the operator switched off.
- **English plurals:** the toasts say '1 sources started being collected' and '1 admissions undone'.

No page errors and no non-loopback requests. The only 400s are my four deliberate merge-refusal probes, each of which rendered its refusal. Everything after consent is not measured here: the one consent popup this row reaches was opened three times, read, screenshotted and cancelled.

items.evidence:

The gap line runs into its note with no full stop:
- en: '2 of 3 collecting sources are not accounted for here This lists admissions made by judging. …'
- fr: '2 des 2 sources collectées ne sont pas expliquées ici Cette liste ne couvre…'
- zh: '…在此无法追溯 此处仅列出…'

en only, ASCII '--':
- 'Admission is about EXTRACTION VALIDITY only -- never editorial merit'

- the merge note '…commit it as configs/source_qualification.yml -- it ships to every fresh install…' (raw_r5.json en.merge_out)

fr, zh and ar render '—'.

Shots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S-recheck/shots/R5-admission-en.png, R5-admission-fr.png, R5-admission-zh.png, R5-admission-ar.png.

The first walk's shot shows the same text, so this predates the fixes, but it was never recorded.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-ai-tools.js:342-345 concatenates tf('{n} of {total} collecting sources are not accounted for here') + ' ' + t(coverage_note). The frame has no terminal punctuation and the note follows on the same line. The en strings are server prose used as keys, written with '--': src/catalog/qualification.py:849-858 (caveat, coverage_note) and src/api/diagnostics/qualification_merge.py:169 (merge note).
items.suggested_fix: End the frame with the locale's full stop in all 12 locales (re-key), or render the count and the note as two block elements. Replace ' -- ' with ' — ' in those three server strings and re-key the en/locale entries.

items.ref: new:The 'Discovered candidates' hover says every disabled source is 'awaiting review', including a qualified source the operator switched off
items.evidence:
Home, 1440 en, fresh seed (raw_r1.json home_en).
- The tile reads '5 Discovered candidates'. Its title/hover reads '5 of your 11 sources: discovered candidates, not enabled, awaiting review. Collection does not reach them.'
- /api/database/stats: sources_candidates 5 = enabled=False rows: candidate-0/1/2, admitted-undone and switched-off.example.
- The app itself shows switched-off.example is not a candidate. Quality gates reads 'qualified: 4' against 'Collecting now: 3', so one qualified source is not enabled. That is switched-off.example (seeded status=qualified, enabled=False), which the hover calls a discovered candidate 'awaiting review'.
- admitted-undone.example is arguably a candidate again, since Undo restores its prior state. The switched-off qualified source is the clear mislabel.
- The Library tile shares the same hover (app-library.js:1014 → homeSourceSplitHover).
items.root_cause: src/static/app-home.js:38 (label 'Discovered candidates') and :46 (hover 'discovered candidates, not enabled, awaiting review') describe a narrower population than the predicate. src/api/database.py:164-166 counts sources_candidates as `enabled IS FALSE`, which includes qualified sources the operator switched off.
items.suggested_fix: Label the figure by its predicate ('Not enabled'), with a hover such as '{n} of your {total} sources are not enabled: discovered candidates, plus any source switched off or whose admission was undone. Collection does not reach them.', keyed ×12. Alternatively, split the predicate (enabled=False AND status!=qualified vs qualified-but-off) so each label is exact, as Q1114 requires.

items.ref: new:English toasts read '1 sources started being collected' and '1 admissions undone'
items.evidence:
Overlay written to my scratch configs (the launcher points DEFAULT_OVERLAY_PATH there; nothing was written into the tree): awaiting→qualified, candidate-0→qualified, candidate-1→disqualified.
- 'Adopt the shipped verdicts' toasted 'Adopted 3 verdicts; 1 sources started being collected.'
- 'Revert them', with its confirm accepted, toasted 'Put back 3 sources; 1 admissions undone.'

Source: raw_r2.json steps.adopt_revert.adopt_toasts / revert_toasts.

The English form itself is wrong. This is a missed site of the one/many pair the fixes applied elsewhere, for example the overlay counts at app-ai-tools.js:417-421. It is not the recorded no-plural-rules design item.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-ai-tools.js:459-460 (overlayAdopt) and :477-478 (overlayRevert) each use a single plural tf() frame for counts that can be 1 ({admitted}, {undone}, and also {n}).
items.suggested_fix: Choose one/many frames by count, as `pair()` in loadOverlayEditor does: 'Adopted {n} verdicts' / '{n} verdict', '{admitted} source started being collected' / '{admitted} sources…', '{undone} admission undone' / '… admissions undone'. Key the new singular frames ×12.

items.ref: new:The backlog line and the memory-floor decline run together with no full stop
items.evidence: Small-memory boot, en. The status line reads '6 candidates awaiting qualification Qualification is declined on this machine…', with no punctuation between the two sentences (raw_r3.json en.bulk). fr reads the same way: '6 candidats en attente de qualification La qualification est refusée…'. Shots: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S-recheck/shots/R-small-bulkline-en.png, R-small-bulkline-fr.png. Same shape as the admission gap line above; found beside item 5 rather than reported by the walker.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-ai-tools.js:606-611. The count phrase `${fmtNum(backlog)} ${t("candidates awaiting qualification")}` has no terminal punctuation, and the decline is appended with `out.textContent += " " + _qualDeclinedText(...)`.
items.suggested_fix: Make the backlog count a keyed frame ending with the locale's full stop, for example tf('{n} candidates awaiting qualification.'), with a one/many pair. Or put the decline on its own line or element.

recheck.summary:
I reproduced all 11 of the walker's items on my own fresh instance of build 0deff9c4, and all 11 are confirmed. I found 1 more P3 beside them.

Setup:
- Encrypted seed: the row-S seed copied to /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/S-recheck. I did not copy any existing data folder.
- Booted locked on :8974 and unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock. The small-memory injection went through the same launcher, and nothing was written into the tree.
- Airplane mode throughout: zero non-loopback requests, no pageerrors.
- The one consent popup (Qualify the backlog) was opened, screenshotted and cancelled.
- Servers were stopped by PID (2706, 4916). `git status` on the tree is clean.

Confirmed items:
- **L375 / the 375 px collapse** is a real regression from the S8 fix (app-ai-tools.js:315 `flex:0 0 auto` with app.css:1771 `min-width:0`).
  - en: the info column is 45.6 px, the row is 212.5 px tall, and the stamp spills 153.7 px out of its column.
  - ar: the stamp spills 72.6 px.
  - Home, Library and Quality gates overflow is still 0, and #home-tier fits.
- **Backlog line stale** after Undo (5 shown vs 6 in the API) and after Adopt (6 vs 3). loadQualificationGates never calls loadQualifyBulk.
- **English on translated pages:**
  - Preview targets (app-sources.js:1514-1525).
  - The memory-floor reason (machine_floor.py → _qualDeclinedText).
  - The merge refusals (MergeInputError text passed verbatim).
- **Qualify the backlog** opens the consent popup although the panel already says this machine declines the job.
- **#qual-enabled** is 188–233 px wide because it is missing `width:auto`.
- **Admission caveats:** the gap line has no full stop in any locale, and the en caveats use ASCII '--'.
- **The 'Discovered candidates' hover** calls a qualified, operator-disabled source 'awaiting review'.
- **Toasts** read '1 sources' and '1 admissions' because they have no one/many pair.

New P3: the backlog count and the memory-floor decline also run together with no full stop.
